description_en: Configures the O\\&M approval setting in a control policy

kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-approval-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --approval-config SwitchStatus=On --region cn-hangzhou

fields.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable O\&M approval in the control policy. Valid values:

- **On**: enables O\&M approval.

- **Off**: disables O\&M approval.
